interface.name: infinity_focus_manager_v1
interface.description:
Malaysia focus mode (ADR 0051): a maximized window gets a space of its own and the xdg fullscreen state. In that space, the pointer at the top edge brings the bar down over the window.
This global tells a client-decorated application when that happens, so it can show its titlebar or window controls only with the bar, as macOS does. It grants nothing, so every client may bind it.
With version 1 objects, or without set_overlay, the compositor moves a client-decorated window down by the bar's height while the bar is down, so its own titlebar stays visible under it. With set_overlay (version 2) the window stays put and the client draws its titlebar over its content, below the bar (Malaysia ADR 0054).

request.name: destroy
request.description: Objects created through it keep working.

request.name: get_focus_surface

description.summary: follow focus mode for a toplevel surface

request.description: Creates an object that reports focus-mode notices for the toplevel whose wl_surface is given.

description.summary: focus mode notices for one toplevel

event.name: bar

description.summary: the bar came down or went up over the window

event.description:
Sent while the toplevel is in focus mode (it has the xdg fullscreen state). revealed is 1 when the bar is down over the window and 0 when the bar is up again. Without set_overlay, the window has been moved down by the bar's height while revealed is 1. A client shows its window controls only while revealed is 1. Leaving focus mode sends 0 if the bar was down.
After set_overlay the window is not moved: the client draws its titlebar from the bar_height sent just before bar(1).

request.name: set_overlay

description.summary: the client draws its titlebar over its content

request.description: Tells the compositor that, in focus mode, this client hides its titlebar and, while the bar is down, draws it over its content right below the bar. The compositor then never moves the window for the bar. It applies from the next time the bar comes down and lasts for the object's lifetime.

event.name: bar_height

description.summary: how much of the window the bar covers

event.description: Sent just before every bar(1) to a client that called set_overlay: the height, in surface-local logical pixels, of the bar over the top of the window. The titlebar goes right below it.
